name: HELDASH
description: HELDASH — A personal homelab dashboard with a clean glass morphism design. Features: Service monitoring, Docker management, Home Assistant integration, Recyclarr/CF Manager, activity logging and more. Bug reports and feature requests welcome via GitHub Issues.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Docker socket for container management and monitoring

paths.name: Recyclarr Config Dir
paths.description: Path to your Recyclarr appdata directory (optional, required for Recyclarr integration)

paths.name: Boot (CA Backup)
paths.description: Optional: Nur für CA Backup Log-Überwachung erforderlich. Pfad: /boot

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the HELDASH web interface

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Required: random secret for session encryption. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: SECURE_COOKIES
variables.description: Set to false for local HTTP access. Set to true when using HTTPS via reverse proxy.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error

variables.name: RECYCLARR_CONFIG_PATH
variables.description: Path to recyclarr.yml inside the Recyclarr container (optional)

variables.name: RECYCLARR_CONTAINER_NAME
variables.description: Name of your Recyclarr Docker container (optional)

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 99)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 100)
